description: 林鐵處_路線車站基本資料 [railways and stations] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 農業部. 「阿里山林業鐵路及文化資產管理處」提供林鐵路線車站基本資料，包含：UpdateTime(更新日期時間)、UpdateInterval(資料更新週期(秒))、AuthorityCode(業管機關簡碼)、LineNo(營運路線所屬之路線編號)、LineID(營運路線所屬之路線代碼)、StationID(車站代碼)、Sequence(站序)、S... Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 農業部. Its tags are 公共資訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in json. The portal shows 2024-05-14 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
